title: Ratnanagari's Rajkaran
subtitle: A Journey Through Shadows and Secrets
summary: When Sarasvatichandra is rescued from the jaws of death by mysterious ascetics on a perilous mountain, he awakens in a world that blurs the boundaries between dream and reality. Guided by enigmatic strangers and haunted by existential questions, his journey promises to unravel hidden truths and test the limits of faith, courage, and destiny. Dive into a tale where every step leads deeper into intrigue and revelation.
